description: First distributed X3 gate. Stage order follows the cluster pipeline: build, then fuzz / simulation / GPU / inference in parallel. Every command is a real repo command; each job runs at the same exact commit in a throwaway worktree on the node that owns its class (or the control node, labelled LOCAL-FALLBACK, when that node does not exist yet).

jobs.name: test-x3-accel
jobs.cmd: cargo test --locked -p x3-accel --features wgpu && cargo test --locked -p x3-accel-wgpu

jobs.name: fuzz-atomic-kernel-rollback
jobs.cmd: mkdir -p "$X3_JOB_OUT/crashes" "$X3_JOB_OUT/corpus" && cd pallets/x3-atomic-kernel && cargo +nightly-2026-08-21 fuzz run fuzz_rollback "$X3_JOB_OUT/corpus" -- -max_total_time=120 -seed=1 -artifact_prefix="$X3_JOB_OUT/crashes/"

jobs.name: gpu-production-gate
jobs.cmd: set +e; bash scripts/gpu-production-gate.sh; rc=$?; mkdir -p "$X3_JOB_OUT/gpu-production"; cp -r audit-artifacts/gpu-production/"$X3_COMMIT"/. "$X3_JOB_OUT/gpu-production"/ 2>/dev/null || true; exit $rc

jobs.name: inference-workers
jobs.cmd: ports=$(awk -F= '/^X3_GPU_WORKERS=/{print $2}' ~/.config/x3-cluster/node.env | tr ',' '\n' | awk -F: '{print $NF}'); [ -n "$ports" ] || { echo "no planned GPU workers"; exit 1; }; for p in $ports; do case "$p" in 1143[4-9]|1144[0-9]) ;; *) echo "invalid worker port $p"; exit 1;; esac; curl -fsS -m 300 http://127.0.0.1:$p/api/generate -d '{"model":"qwen2.5-coder:7b","prompt":"Reply with the single word: ok","stream":false,"options":{"num_predict":8}}' -o "$X3_JOB_OUT/worker-$p.json" || { echo "worker :$p failed"; exit 1; }; echo "worker :$p ok"; done; ls "$X3_JOB_OUT"/worker-*.json
